title: Billing Calendar: Next-Period Rent Collected with a Catch-Up Payment on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
When a delinquent Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is brought current, the payment also collects toward the next billing period according to how near the next rent due date is.

**Next rent due date.** The day after the last day of the most recently charged billing period.

**Collection.** Counting calendar days from the handling date to the next rent due date:

| Next rent due date is | Collected toward the next period, added to the amount to pay |
|---|---|
| no more than 7 days away (including a date already reached) | the next period's contracted monthly rent in full |
| more than 7 but no more than 14 days away | half (0.5) of the next period's contracted monthly rent |
| more than 14 days away | nothing |

The rent collected is the contracted monthly rent of the agreement, not a discounted rent charge. The share collected is added to the amount to pay and the total is rounded to the cent.

### Calendar boundaries (hypothetical; most recent period 9 May to 8 June, so the next due date is 9 June; contracted rent $180.00)

| Handling date | Days to 9 June | Collected |
|---|---|---|
| 2 June | 7 | $180.00 |
| 1 June | 8 | $90.00 |
| 26 May | 14 | $90.00 |
| 25 May | 15 | nothing |
